content.short: distrikt is a decentralized professional social media platform on the blockchain.
content.description: distrikt is a decentralized social platform built on the Internet Computer. It lets users create and use accounts via Internet Identity, enhancing privacy and security. Run by a Swiss non-profit, the Open Internet Foundation, distrikt provides a blockchain-driven space for professionals to connect, share, and collaborate. Key features include a cryptocurrency wallet and a community-driven tipping system that supports peer-to-peer interactions.
